image_description: The image displays two traffic light units suspended against a cloudy sky and a modern building facade. The primary subject is a vertical traffic light on the left, showing an illuminated red signal at the top, with unlit amber and green signals below. It features distinct visors over each lens and is mounted via a bracket to overhead wires. A second, smaller or more distant traffic light hangs to the right, appearing yellowish/tan in color, also with three lenses and visors. Overhead utility wires crisscross the upper portion of the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The surface texture of the right-hand traffic light appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like compared to the more detailed metallic look of the left one, potentially indicating minor generation inconsistency or simplification.

artifact_observations.location: Mounting bracket of left traffic light
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection point between the top of the left traffic light and the suspension wire/bracket is somewhat ambiguous. The metalwork looks slightly fused or indistinct rather than having sharp, separate mechanical components.

Some of the thinner overhead wires appear to fade out or merge into the sky/background abruptly without a clear continuation, a common minor artifact in AI-generated scenes with complex linear elements.
